required_semantics: Date selection is parameter-driven so it does not remove hierarchy members before densification.
ZN converts densified null order counts to zero.
INDEX on Detail triggers domain completion for missing weekday and hierarchy combinations.
Sub-Category and Manufacturer totals use Average rather than Sum.
The Apply worksheet sends selected minimum and maximum dates to pMinDate and pMaxDate.
observable_assertions: The workbook contains the two date parameters and required calculation chain.
The table worksheet uses Category, Sub-Category, Manufacturer, and weekday.
The table worksheet contains INDEX detail densification and Average subtotal metadata.
The Apply worksheet contains a context date filter and Min/Max date fields.
The dashboard contains both worksheets and two parameter actions.
allowed_differences: Exact colors, borders, shading, fonts, padding, and tooltip prose may differ.
The auxiliary deselect action may be omitted when the two parameter actions preserve repeated Apply behavior.
Date parameter controls may be shown in addition to the Apply worksheet.
